title: Speed up production watcher lifecycle checks

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage for SEED-311

**Verdict — Caught.** The maintained held-commit case caught the old production preview exiting before an accepted native Codex start settled. With the fault active, a passive scratch observer independently recorded the real drain returning HTTP 200 while the persisted accepted attempt had no outcome or settlement timestamp. The assertion that the old preview PID was alive at admission closure failed at line 86. [Maintained assertion](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/3bbfccce72710635244d20c884728d9d2cb98c22/dashboard/tests/runtime/productionHeldUpdate.ts#L79-L93)

**Promise and fault.** At revision `3bbfccce72710635244d20c884728d9d2cb98c22`, B must replace A only after accepted starts settle. In a detached scratch clone I removed only `await this.owner.drain();` from `AgentLaunches.drain()`, leaving the admission closure, actual Vite and Git fixture, launch-store lock, native Codex process, and maintained assertions intact. [Story promise](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/3bbfccce72710635244d20c884728d9d2cb98c22/.planning/seeds/SEED-311-production-watcher-lifecycle-checks.md#key-examples) · [Fault location](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/3bbfccce72710635244d20c884728d9d2cb98c22/dashboard/server/agentLaunches.ts#L60-L63)

**Run and restoration.** The ordinary strict dashboard runner used one worker for the unchanged-main prerequisite and the held-commit case. Baseline 2/2 passed. With the fault, unchanged main passed and held-commit failed at the old-preview assertion. The observer saw a settled launched outcome at HTTP 200 on the baseline and restored runs, and an unsettled attempt at HTTP 200 on the faulted run. The pre-probe and restored Git states were clean at the same detached revision. The restored 2/2 passed and the scratch clone was removed. Every case ran on its first attempt. [Selected tests](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/3bbfccce72710635244d20c884728d9d2cb98c22/dashboard/tests/runtime/production-watcher-updates.spec.ts#L33-L64)

**Next proof action.** Keep the maintained old-preview and durable-settlement observations in the ordinary watcher selection. This probe supports the existing launch-store lock repair for the tested path.

- **Test runtime.** Measured by the strict runner at 22.81 s baseline, 20.31 s faulted, and 20.94 s restored, 64.06 s total. Whole-command wall times under `caffeinate -s -i` on AC macOS were 23.69 s, 20.69 s, and 21.31 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. Human time was not measured separately.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active work was not separately timed from the runner and setup.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 195087 ms (measured), from 1794392266137 to 1794392461224 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Keep the held-commit proof in ordinary CI. The scratch check at `3bbfccce72710635244d20c884728d9d2cb98c22` caught early preview retirement when the native attempt was still pending. The later correction at `17d4a8494b2ef09b731dbcce5b8354e892b2fad2` changed only native executable lookup and retained the same production drain, lock and assertions. The clean-PATH one-worker update selector passed all 10 checks. No follow-up is needed for this observation.

The [completed plan](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/b2f84f3854abd116dc1a801f2d284e0acd9e1802/.planning/slice-plans/589-speed-up-production-watcher-lifecycle-checks/PLAN.md) retains the whole-command timings and coverage evidence.
